header.authority: HM Revenue and Customs, United Kingdom
header.instrument: Benchmark scale rates for subsistence, Income Tax (Earnings and Pensions) Act 2003 s.289A, published at EIM05231
header.note: The benchmark rates are the maximum that may be paid free of tax without receipts. They are payable only for a meal the traveller actually buys while on a qualifying journey, and only when a checking system is in place. They are not a lodging allowance.

bands.label: 15 hours or more and ongoing at 8pm

rates.note: A supplementary late-evening rate of 10.00 GBP may be paid on top of the 5-hour or 10-hour rate when the journey is ongoing at 8pm and the traveller had to buy a meal after that time. This server does not add it automatically: whether a meal was bought after 8pm is a fact the caller has to supply, so it is exposed as late_evening on perdiem_calc.
